images.caption: Alternate cover — black-and-white copperplate engraving
images.style_prompt: Black-and-white copperplate engraving in the manner of an 18th-century scientific engraving, purely pictorial: a serene giant sage-like machine in flowing Taoist robes meditating on a misty mountaintop while smaller machines ascend and drift away into the clouds like a departing flock of birds, the quiet ordered city far below.

images.caption: Alternate cover — Chinese ink wash
images.style_prompt: Chinese shui-mo ink-wash painting, purely pictorial with no text: a robed traveler dissolving into mist among mountain peaks, an overturned bucket on the slope, a crescent moon — wu wei and the disappearance.
